scientific_summary: For every positive power r, the Pearson correlation of stationary renewal age^r and residual-life^r has an exact universal attainable interval determined by beta-function constants; deterministic interarrivals attain the lower endpoint, two-point laws approach the upper endpoint, and exponential interarrivals give the exact zero-correlation threshold.
limitations: The theorem is stationary and concerns equal powers; the upper endpoint is not attained; raw Schur-constant moment identities and the r=1 correlation are prior results; older Schur-constant literature remains a residual originality risk.
